brief: Brightpath CRM is a US business software company with 640 staff, 85 of them in support, working remotely. Its careers page shows the team runs an older helpdesk tool, it has 6 open support roles with the latest posted in December 2025, it raised funding in the last 12 months and it just named a new support leader. Start with the VP of Support, with the support operations lead as champion: a new leader plus an aging tool is the opening.

Ledgerloop is a US financial technology company with 1,200 staff and a support team of 140 that answers customers from shared email inboxes. It has 9 open support roles, publishes a support SLA, and recently named a new head of customer experience. Because it is a regulated business, the Head of Support Operations is the likely owner, with the security owner joining the review and the support operations lead as champion.

Tallyforge is a remote US business software company of 420 people with a 60 person support team on an older helpdesk tool. It is hiring 4 more support staff, the latest role posted in December 2025, and it raised funding in the last 12 months, so the team is growing on a tool it will soon outgrow. The Head of Support owns the tools here and is the person to start with.

Quaystack is a Canadian business software company with 900 staff, a hybrid team, and 110 people in support working tickets in an older helpdesk tool. It has 7 open support roles, publishes a support SLA and has a new support leader. Start with the VP of Support, with the support operations lead as champion, since new leaders tend to review the tool stack in their first months.

Meridian Pay is a US financial technology company with 2,300 staff and 260 in support, who handle partner requests across shared email inboxes. It has 12 open support roles, raised funding in the last 12 months and publishes a support SLA. As a regulated business the Head of Support Operations is the likely owner, with the security owner in the review and the support operations lead as champion.

Harborlane Logistics is a US logistics company with 1,800 staff working from the office and a support team of 70 that runs on shared email inboxes. Hiring is slow, with 2 open support roles and the last one posted in September 2025, and there is no recent funding or new leader. Worth a conversation with the Head of Support once the hot accounts are worked, framed around moving off email.

Pinecrest HR is a small UK business software company of 150 people, fully remote, with 18 support staff on an older helpdesk tool. It has 1 open support role, posted in November 2025, and no recent funding or new leader. The team sits near the bottom of the size the product is built for, so lead with the Head of Support and keep the ask small.

Fernway Insurance Tech is a US insurance technology company with 520 staff in the office and 35 in support. Its public pages name no support tool, it publishes a support SLA, and its only open support role dates from April 2025, so timing is quiet. As a regulated business the Head of Support Operations is the likely owner, with the support operations lead as champion and security in the review.

Bluefinch Health is a US healthcare company with 1,500 staff, hybrid, and a support team of 120 working from shared email inboxes. It has 5 open support roles and a recently hired director of support. Healthcare means data handling gets reviewed, so the Head of Support Operations is the likely owner, with the security owner joining and the support operations lead as champion.

Northgate Legal Cloud is a remote US legal technology company with 260 staff and a support team of 30. It raised funding in the last 12 months and has 2 open support roles, the latest from December 2025, while its public pages name no support tool. Legal data means a security review, so start with the Head of Support Operations and bring the support operations lead in as champion.

Copperline IT Services is a US services firm with 480 staff in the office and 60 in support, running an older helpdesk tool and publishing a support SLA. It has 3 open support roles, the latest from October 2025. Services firms fit less well than software companies, so treat this as a second wave account and open with the Head of Support.

Driftwood Apps is an Australian business software company of 220 people, fully remote, with 28 in support answering from shared email inboxes. It has 2 open support roles, the latest from November 2025, and no recent funding or new leader. A small team still on email is a clean fit for a first shared inbox, so the Head of Support is the person to start with.

Parcelpoint is a US logistics marketplace with 6,500 staff and 350 in support on an older helpdesk tool, which is above the team size the product is built for. It has 8 open support roles, raised funding in the last 12 months and has a new support leader. The VP of Support is the likely owner, with the support operations lead as champion, but check whether one regional team is a better first step.

Velvetkey Security is a US business software company with 750 staff, hybrid, and 55 in support. Its support and careers pages name no support tool, it publishes a support SLA, and it has 5 open support roles with the latest from December 2025, after raising funding in the last 12 months. A growing team with no named tool is worth an early call with the Head of Support.
